purpose: Track exhaustive source-page body review separately from collection row/property census coverage without publishing private GM prose.
privacy_rule: Persist page IDs, edit timestamps, content hashes and review dispositions only. Do not publish private Notion page bodies in this standalone repository.
known_limitation: The live census proves collection membership and query-visible properties. VALIDATION_STANDALONE.md explicitly records that the detailed Registry page-body snapshot is private and intentionally unpublished. No existing checked-in artifact proves exhaustive body reads across all retained source records.
completion_rule: COMPLETE only when every retained core record has a body-read receipt or an explicit no-body/not-applicable disposition, with stable source ID, source revision/edit timestamp, content hash where a body exists, and economic review disposition.

historical_checkpoint.note: Historical acquisition checkpoint only. Later selective reads are not promoted to exhaustive body-review receipts.
